title: common/pkg/hooks: log stdout/err on hook errors and some minor improvements
body:
common/pkg/hooks: return single error when running hook

Returning two errors when in many case both are the same is rather
confusing for the callers as they need to check both and the caller does
not really know which one is which.

We can combine two root cause error into one with %w so the callers
errors.Is matching on a context timeout still works fine with this.

This is a breaking change but only podman uses these and I will update
the callers there. But this should make the following changes easier.

And if we do a breaking change we might as well remove the deprecated
functions as well.

---

common/pkg/hooks: use t.Context() in tests

The context will be canceled when the test is done so it is a bit better
to avoid leaks.

---

common/pkg/hooks: log stdout/err on hook errors

When we execute a hook and it fails add the stdout and stderr output to
the error if they are not empty.

This allows users to easily debug and understand why a hook fails as it
can just print its errors to stderr like a normal application does.

Fixes: #1264

comments.body: Fixed, also while looking at it I also did one more minor cleanup to use time.After which is simpler and fine since go 1.23
